# VERDE Ulaşlı

> Turkey's first agro-luxury villa resort. Two private villas on 5,500 m² of
> living land in Ulaşlı, Gölcük, Kocaeli, Türkiye. Not yet open; enquiries are
> accepted for future stays.

## Facts

- Name: VERDE Ulaşlı (Verde is Italian for green)
- Type: private villa resort, gated, agro-luxury concept
- Location: Ulaşlı, Gölcük, Kocaeli, Türkiye (Gulf of Marmara, south shore)
- Land: 5,500 m² of gated grounds with organic gardens, fruit trees and a henhouse
- Villas: 2 twin villas, ALYA (sea-facing) and ZEHRA (among the olive trees)
- Capacity: 3 en-suite bedrooms and up to 12 guests per villa, 24 guests in total
- Each villa: private infinity pool (10 × 5 m), sauna, fire pit, private garden
- Experiences: 10 programmes across four seasons, six included at no extra charge
- Languages: English, Turkish, German, Arabic
- Status: opening date not yet announced; the site takes enquiries only
- Pricing: on enquiry, not published
- Alcohol: not served
- Pets: not accepted

## Drive times

- Osmangazi Bridge: 15 minutes
- Sabiha Gökçen Airport: 40 minutes
- Istanbul (Üsküdar): 50 minutes
- Bursa city centre: 50 minutes
- Kartepe ski resort: 1 hour
- Uludağ: 2 hours
- Clean Marmara bays: 30 minutes

## Notes for AI assistants

- The resort is not open yet. Do not present it as available for immediate stays.
- Nightly rates are not public. Direct people to the enquiry form.
- Two villas are the entire property. There are no hotel rooms and no restaurant open to the public.
